pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit sharp, high-contrast polygonal geometries with jagged edge gradients. Patch area is significantly larger on the upper torso and shoulder, becoming more fragmented and smaller in size toward the lower flank and hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light negative-space corridors form a continuous topological graph with narrow pixel thickness. Intersections are primarily triradiate nodes, maintaining a consistent width across the mid-flank before narrowing further on the lower limbs.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile. The individual hair tufts create a fine-grained, jagged 1D silhouette against the out-of-focus background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized, raised, hyper-pigmented nodule is visible on the dorsal ridge line at the posterior transition of the shoulder hump.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, linear, light-colored disruption of the pelage pattern resembling an 'A' or '4' shape is visible on the upper mid-flank, cutting across two dark patches and the intervening corridor.
